Weapon Handler

Manages weapon equipping, switching, and usage for entities.

Component Mob

Schema

JSON
{
  "weaponHandler": {}
}

Description

The Weapon Handler component manages weapon equipping, switching, and usage for entities. It serves as the bridge between an entity and its weapons, handling the logic for selecting and using different weapons during gameplay.

Fields

FieldTypeDescription
Weapon handler configuration is managed through weapon components attached to the entity.

Example

JSON
{
  "weaponHandler": {}
}
